title: OGRR-Net: observation-guided residual refinement learning for photoacoustic imaging
authors: Qi Liu; Fengchen Luo; Hengrong Lan; Fei Gao; Siyu Liu
summary_en: Observation-guided residual refinement uses an initial photoacoustic reconstruction plus a raw-sinogram-derived guidance map to reduce artifacts and preserve structural detail.

title: Uncovering hidden structural and mechanical contrast via spectral photoacoustic imaging
authors: Ang Li; Junxiang Zhao; Hongki Lee; Zhaowei Liu
summary_en: Spectral photoacoustic imaging uses broadband acoustic spectra and frequency-resolved modal patterns to reveal structural and mechanical signatures that are weak or invisible in conventional optical-absorption contrast.

title: Human carotid plaque risk imaging using multiparametric photoacoustic and ultrasound fusion (hCAPRI)
authors: Minsik Sung; Sunghun Nam; Sun Oh Kim; Jong-Il Park; Dong Young Jeong; Yujung Jung; Changyeop Lee; Moongyu Han; Hong-Ju Kim; Jun-Chang Jeong; Kwanju Song; Jeong Yoon Song; Jae Young Park; Hyeseon Lee; Bum Joon Kim; Byullee Park; Ung Kim; Chulhong Kim
summary_en: hCAPRI fuses photoacoustic intraplaque-hemorrhage information with ultrasound structural parameters for real-time carotid plaque risk assessment; the study covers 171 carotid arteries from 120 patients and validates against MRI.

title: Theoretical and Experimental Study of Photoacoustic Spectral Intraoperative Pathological Assessment Using Oral and Breast Cases
authors: Xiaojing Wu; Zhengduo Yang; Fan Yang; Yong Yang; Siwei Zhu; Li Zhang; Changyu Shen; Xiaocong Yuan
summary_en: Broadband photoacoustic spectral analysis is developed and validated theoretically and experimentally for label-free discrimination of normal and cancerous oral and breast tissues, including fresh and in-vivo specimens.

title: Hybrid Confocal Fluorescence and Photoacoustic Microscopy for In-Depth and Noninvasive Imaging of Biomolecule-Functionalized 3D Scaffolds
authors: Eudokia Kyriakou; George J. Tserevelakis; Konstantina Terzaki; Petros Tavlas; Chrysanthi Pinelopi Apostolidou; Stefanos Mavrikos; Costas P. Grigoropoulos; Anna Mitraki; Maria Farsari; Giannis Zacharakis
summary_en: A nondestructive hybrid microscope combines frequency-domain photoacoustic microscopy and confocal fluorescence to volumetrically characterize biomolecule-functionalized 3D scaffolds and separate photoacoustic peptide contrast from scaffold autofluorescence.
